research_feedback.binder_architecture_implication: The intended learned module is closer to an episode-local routing/binding operator than a static steering direction. Training should jointly measure semantic decode preservation, local-codebook routing accuracy, and control specificity.
research_feedback.falsifier: If post-FT unseen-permutation/template accuracy rises while nuisance/permuted controls reproduce the effect, or consumed-input identity cannot be cross-bound, the binder claim is not causally isolated and must not be promoted.
research_feedback.harness_implication: The Go/Xeno harness should preserve fields for semantic_readability, target_behavior_delta, nuisance/control deltas, mapping_digest, prompt_bytes_digest, token_tensor_digest including dtype/shape, holdout_freeze_id and matched_control_completeness.
research_feedback.new_gate_rule: A promotion gate must not trust hardcoded independence flags, incomplete family topology or aliased control identities. Missing evidence is a blocking state, not a default true.
research_feedback.new_provenance_rule: Consumed model input identity must be a single causal object binding rendered prompt bytes and exact token tensor values/order/dtype/shape under tokenizer/template/runtime identity.
research_feedback.new_training_rule: Representational transport and behavioral semantic control are separate targets. A training/eval row may teach the former only as mechanism evidence; semantic-control promotion requires held-out behavioral consequence plus matched-control specificity.
